Liam Fitzgerald  
📍 Bangalore, India | +91 98765 43210 | l.fitzgerald@example.com | linkedin.com/in/liamfitzgerald | github.com/liamfitzgerald  

Professional Experience / Work History  
At NexCart Technologies, I transitioned from a junior ML engineer to a senior role, driving scalable infrastructure for real-time pricing and customer analytics. As a junior engineer, I designed NLP pipelines using Hugging Face Transformers to analyze customer sentiment, integrating models into AWS SageMaker endpoints that processed over 500k daily interactions. This work laid the foundation for a recommendation system that increased average order value by 12% through personalized search rankings. In my senior role, I spearheaded the development of a feature store using PyTorch and TensorFlow, enabling seamless model retraining and reducing inference latency by 30%. The system now powers dynamic pricing models that adapt to market trends, contributing to a 15% improvement in revenue predictability. Prior to NexCart, I interned at RetailGenie Inc., where I collaborated on recommendation models that enhanced user engagement by 8% through collaborative filtering and embedding techniques.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
My work spans full ML lifecycle management, from data preprocessing to production deployment. I routinely use MLflow for tracking experiments and Weights & Biases for visualizing training metrics, ensuring reproducibility in complex workflows. For NLP tasks, I leverage Hugging Face Transformers to build sentiment analysis models that integrate with REST APIs, enabling real-time feedback loops for customer service teams. My expertise in AWS extends beyond basic deployment— I optimized EC2 clusters for batch inference, reduced cold start times for SageMaker endpoints, and implemented CI/CD pipelines that cut model rollout delays by 40%. I’ve also leveraged scikit-learn for prototyping, often as a lightweight alternative to TensorFlow when rapid iteration is critical.  

Projects / Side Projects  
At NexCart, I led a project to refactor legacy recommendation systems, replacing static models with a hybrid approach combining collaborative filtering and deep learning. This resulted in a 22% increase in conversion rates during peak shopping seasons. Independently, I developed a side project using PyTorch to build a real-time chatbot for e-commerce customer support, which achieved 92% accuracy in intent classification and was later adapted for internal use. Another project involved creating a feature store with Apache Arrow, which streamlined data sharing across teams and reduced preprocessing time by 25%.  

Education  
Master of Science in Data Science, Carnegie Mellon University, 2021. Thesis focused on optimizing model inference pipelines for e-commerce platforms, with a particular emphasis on latency reduction in distributed systems.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hindi (professional working proficiency), Tamil (basic conversational).  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty (2023), Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2022).  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as NexCart’s “Innovation Champion” for spearheading the feature store project, which became a cornerstone of the company’s MLOps strategy. Received a Best Thesis Award at CMU for research on real-time model optimization in high-traffic environments.
